title: Single hieratic sign, London, British Museum, EA 10672 (AKU HT 65944)

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 65944

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 65944; AKU grapheme H0020 (AKU GR 297). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: H2 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 232, 232 (v4p3). Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1936a. Occurrence: line 12; find place Tanis; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 5.1 x 5.3 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Römische Zeit". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
